leading_positions.synthesis: Two members prefer targeted protein degradation as a single part with the identical trio Crews, Deshaies and Handa. Their citations differ: Aili-Daniel's is for small molecules that harness the ubiquitin-proteasome system to induce degradation; Chabes's names induced-proximity degraders and the cereblon mechanism of molecular glues explicitly. Both accept that no heterobifunctional PROTAC is yet approved and that Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto, Ito and Kim are left out. Beyond these two, B010 is listed as an alternative by aqvist-johan, somfai-peter, sparr-emma and zou-xiaodong, and is not a preferred configuration for them.

Two members prefer biomolecular phase separation as a single part with the identical trio Hyman, Brangwynne and Rosen. Linke's citation stresses discovery that multivalent weak interactions organize the cell interior; Sparr's frames it as a physical-chemical principle, with less commitment to cellular function. Both acknowledge that Pappu and Mittag fall outside a three-person limit and that which in-cell condensates are truly phase-separated and functionally essential is unsettled. Aili-daniel, somfai-peter and zou-xiaodong each express doubt about the cellular evidence or the fit with chemistry.

Two members prefer palladium-catalyzed C-N cross-coupling as a single part with the pair Buchwald and Hartwig, both leaving out Kosugi. The citations are similar (general method for C-N coupling; somfai-peter adds arylamines). Both flag the 2010 cross-coupling prize and the Kosugi tin-amide precedent as the main risks. Brzezinski states that it is outside his own field and wants an expert report on organometallic catalysis; Somfai rates it less conceptually novel than B010 or B011.

One member prefers massively parallel sequencing as a single part with two laureates, Balasubramanian and Klenerman, citing reversible-terminator sequencing-by-synthesis on clustered surfaces. This deliberately omits Rothberg (454), Mayer and Ju. B011 appears as an alternative for aili-daniel, chabes-andrei, linke-heiner and somfai-peter, but none of them prefers it as first choice.

One member prefers molecular-sieve catalyst design as a single part with Corma, Davis and Zones, using a narrow citation on structure-directing synthesis. This leaves out Yu and Tsapatsis, which the member flags as a contested boundary. She discloses a possible field overlap and names B058 as a fallback; no other member lists B002 as a preference or alternative.

areas_of_agreement: All eight members submitted a single-part configuration, so no member has yet proposed a multi-part prize or a pairing of two ballot topics.

B010 is the most widely cited alternative and every member except brzezinski-peter lists it as a first choice or an alternative; no member disputes its scientific merit, and disagreement concerns citation and timing.
B011 is regarded by several members as a major, mature advance; disagreement concerns attribution among the Solexa, 454 and related lineages and whether it is chemistry-led.

Members agree that three-person limits and omitted contributors are real constraints in B010, B046 and B002, and that priority claims should be verified against expert reports because several members state they rely on supplied credit lists or memory.
No member reports a conflict that would require recusal; all disclosed items are field proximity or institutional overlap.
scientific_disputes: B046: whether in-cell condensates are equilibrium phase-separated and functionally essential, or whether the in vitro physical chemistry is the part that can bear a citation. Aili-daniel, somfai-peter and zou-xiaodong press this; linke-heiner and sparr-emma acknowledge it.
B010: whether heterobifunctional degraders (PROTACs) and cereblon-based molecular glues are one discovery or two, and so whether one citation can honestly cover both.
B011: whether sequencing-by-synthesis is a chemical discovery or technology-company engineering, and whether it fits Chemistry rather than Medicine or Physiology.
B035: whether C-N coupling is a distinct achievement from the Pd cross-coupling honoured in 2010, as somfai-peter argues, or an extension of that logic, as brzezinski-peter and aqvist-johan note.
B058: whether the unsettled N2 binding mode and catalytic cycle make nitrogenase unready, although the structural evidence is accepted.
attribution_disputes: B010: the PROTAC concept (Crews, Deshaies, Sakamoto), structure-guided ligand work (Ciulli) and the cereblon/glue strand (Handa, Ito, Gray) are different contributions; a Crews-Deshaies-Handa trio leaves out Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto, Ito and Kim, and aili-daniel and chabes-andrei both ask whether Handa or Ciulli is the better third name.
B011: Balasubramanian and Klenerman (Solexa chemistry) versus Rothberg (454 pyrosequencing platform), with Mayer and Ju contested; aqvist-johan asks whether to keep one lineage or add a third name.

B046: the Hyman-Brangwynne and Rosen strands are related but not identical, and Pappu and Mittag's sequence-encoded grammar is excluded; linke-heiner, sparr-emma and zou-xiaodong all raise the choice among Rosen, Pappu and Mittag.
B035: Kosugi's earlier tin-amide coupling and Migita-type precedent; somfai-peter and brzezinski-peter treat it as precedent but disagree on whether it needs more than a careful citation.
B002: priority between early zeolite pioneers and design-era contributors, and the omission of Yu and Tsapatsis.
maturity_disputes: B010: no heterobifunctional PROTAC is yet approved, so clinical impact rests on late-stage trials and on glue-class medicines whose mechanism was explained retrospectively. Aqvist-johan places it behind B011 for this reason; aili-daniel, chabes-andrei and somfai-peter want the trial status confirmed.
B046: sparr-emma notes the prize would be early compared with B010, B035 or B011, which have already delivered at scale; linke-heiner accepts that the physiological claims are unsettled.
B011 and B035 are accepted as mature; the dispute there is about attribution and novelty, not timing.
B002 and the 2025 MOF prize: zou-xiaodong asks whether another porous-materials award is too close in time.
conflict_or_recusal_flags: zou-xiaodong discloses that she may know and cite Yu and Tsapatsis (B002) through the porous-materials community and that her field is zeolite electron crystallography; she asks the committee to judge whether recusal on B002 is warranted.
brzezinski-peter discloses scientific closeness to B043 and B058 and that Xiaodong Zou is a Stockholm University colleague; disclosed for transparency, not as a recusal ground.

sparr-emma discloses that her research on lipid and protein self-assembly is scientifically close to B046 and B051, with no personal or institutional tie to any credited candidate; she and somfai-peter also note the Lund institutional overlap with the chair.
aqvist-johan discloses scientific closeness to B038 (Car-Parrinello) with no personal tie to Car or Parrinello, and no recusal needed.

linke-heiner (chair) reports no tie to any shortlisted candidate; his nanophysics interest in molecular motors is a perspective, not a connection. Aili-daniel and chabes-andrei report no specific conflict.
questions_for_round2: B010: can the committee draft one defensible sentence that covers heterobifunctional degraders and cereblon-based glues, or must the strands be separated, and which third name (Handa or Ciulli) does that sentence support?
B010: is the absence of an approved PROTAC drug disqualifying, and what do the expert reports say about the status of late-stage trials and approved glue-class medicines?
B046: does the committee credit the in vitro thermodynamic framework or the claim that condensates organize living cells, and which third laureate (Rosen, Pappu or Mittag) fits that choice?

B011: should the citation cover one sequencing-by-synthesis lineage (Balasubramanian and Klenerman) or also 454 (Rothberg), and is the discovery chemistry rather than a platform or technology outcome?
B035: does the committee accept that C-N coupling is distinct from the 2010 Pd cross-coupling prize, and how should Kosugi's precedent be handled in the citation?
Given that no configuration has more than two explicit supporters, which supporters of B010, B046, B035, B011 and B002 can rank another member's candidate as acceptable, and on what condition?
B002: should zou-xiaodong be recused from B002, and if so, does her view on B058 as a fallback stand?
summary.chair_observation: No ballot has more than two explicit first-choice supporters among eight members, and the five distinct single-part preferences (B010, B046, B035, B011, B002) leave a majority of five unreachable without movement. B010 is the common alternative and B011 follows, but support as an alternative is not the same as support as a preferred configuration. Most disputes concern citation wording, third names and maturity rather than the merit of the underlying science. The chair's own preference is B046, and he is one of the two supporters recorded for it.
